SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) s, MAX(calendar_date) e, COUNT(*) n,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS distinct_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS distinct_ids
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5 GROUP BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sl AS (
  SELECT f.*, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) rl,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND business_date=sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_same_day,
 SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 AND business_date<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_diff,
 MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at), COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at)
FROM sl WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT n.sku, SUM(n.net_sales) net_sales, SUM(n.units) units
  FROM net_lines n WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) rnk, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units DESC) unit_rnk, a.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand, a.net_sales, a.units
FROM agg a JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=a.sku AND cp.is_current
ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 20

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
l AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, s.store_id, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
   AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   AND p.sku IN (100955,100927,103415,103434,102116,101398,103329,101411,101022,101375)
)
SELECT sku, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(net_amount) gross_of_returns, MAX(net_amount) max_line, MAX(quantity) max_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) stores, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) web_net,
 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p2 ON p2.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p2.sku=l.sku AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') returns_in_period
FROM l GROUP BY sku ORDER BY 3 DESC

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rank, n.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY n.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
